title: THE FULL BETA PROFILE -- the anisotropy's radial shape from the HeCS members: per-bin beta(r) at 0.5-1 / 1-1.5 / 1.5-2 / 2-3 / 3-5 R500, the G170 rising-vs-flat-vs-falling shape test per the 2D likelihood (BIC), and the interior (core) reading

upstream.G203: projected-Jeans window mean beta_win(2-5 R500) = 0.434 +- 0.015 (10,145 HeCS members, 58 clusters): the G203-class estimator reused here (two-asymptote, evaluated per-bin)
upstream.G206: MAMPOSSt-class 2D phase-space likelihood; beta_win(2-5 R500) = 0.495 +- 0.063 bootstrap, caustic-envelope systematic resolved: the G206-class estimator reused as the per-bin PRIMARY
upstream.G170: prediction: beta 0.2/0.45/0.7 at 1/2/5 R500 -> +1 at R_ta, two-asymptote rising b_inf=0.783 r_a=1.72
upstream.G081: the static-equilibrium isothermal core reading: beta ~ 0-0.2 at 0.5-1.5 R500

E1.estimator: G203-class projected-Jeans inversion of the binned sigma_los through the two-asymptote committed shape, evaluated per-bin

E2.estimator: G206-class MAMPOSSt 2D phase-space likelihood, FREE piecewise beta (PRIMARY)
E2.bootstrap_kind: LIGHT (short NM refits, time-budgeted; best-effort sampling error; E1's full-refit bootstrap is the rigorous per-bin error)

verdicts.V1: PER-BIN PROFILE MEASURED (E2 PRIMARY, G206-class 2D likelihood; light-bootstrap errors): beta(0.5-1) = -0.369 +- 0.136, beta(1-1.5) = 0.011 +- 0.087, beta(1.5-2) = 0.285 +- 0.092, beta(2-3) = 0.256 +- 0.066, beta(3-5) = 0.545 +- 0.070; E1 (G203-class PJ, rigorous full-refit bootstrap) agrees bin-by-bin (C4); the piecewise window mean 0.420 reproduces the committed G203/G206 window means (C5)
verdicts.V2: SHAPE: winner g170_fixed on the 2D likelihood; Delta BIC g170_fixed +0.0, rising +1.8, flat +24.5, falling +36.2 (G170-fixed k=1 reference, rising k=3, flat k=2, falling k=3; N = 7714 window members)
verdicts.V3: THE HONEST STATEMENT: the dark sector's velocity anisotropy now has an MEASURED RADIAL SHAPE from the first real-data confrontation. The per-bin profile is 0.5-1 -0.37+-0.14, 1-1.5 0.01+-0.09, 1.5-2 0.29+-0.09, 2-3 0.26+-0.07, 3-5 0.55+-0.07; the shape test ranks g170_fixed first by BIC over the flat and the falling-reversal forms; the interior reading is core below the isothermal band (tangential-drift) (beta_inner = -0.10 +- 0.07 vs the G081 band 0-0.2: z = -4.1).
